verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a community report that users can delete their AngelList accounts via profile picture > Settings > Delete account. That is a product-provided deletion path, but it is not documented first-party and covers only whole-account deletion. Cap table export and migration to other providers concern portability, not retention or deletion, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of account or data deletion, data retention policies or controls, granular deletion of specific records, confirmation of what is purged and when, and any AI-feature (e.g., Tie Out Assistant) data-handling controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: One shared the steps: profile picture > Settings > Delete account.
